summary: Implemented the Databricks OAuth profile mapping. Added cosmos/profiles/databricks/oauth.py with DatabricksOauthProfileMapping (required fields host, schema, http_path, client_id, client_secret; client_id from login or extra.client_id; client_secret from password or extra.client_secret; profile sets auth_type oauth and env-var refs for both secrets, with profile args applied before the fixed fields). Registered it directly after DatabricksTokenProfileMapping in profile_mappings and added it to the export lists in cosmos/profiles/__init__.py and cosmos/profiles/databricks/__init__.py. Added tests/profiles/databricks/test_dbr_oauth.py covering claim checks, token-vs-OAuth selection, profile output, override protection, and env vars. Tests were not run and no code was executed, per instructions; verification was by reading only. Nothing was committed.
